diceRoller.title: Dice Roller
diceRoller.description: Roll up to 10 dice at once. Auto-calculates sum, max, min, and average

whatIs.title: What is Dice Roller?
whatIs.description: An online dice tool for board games, TRPG, and probability learning. Roll up to 10 dice simultaneously with D4/D6/D8/D10/D12/D20 options and automatic sum/max/min/average calculation.

howToUse.title: How to Use
items: Set the number of dice (1-10) and sides (4/6/8/10/12/20).
Set a modifier (+/-) to automatically adjust the total.
Check history and distribution for previous rolls.

tips.title: Tips
items: D&D/TRPG: Use various dice combos like 4d6 for ability scores.
Replaces physical dice for board games.
Great for probability experiments in class.

items.a: Yes, it supports D4/D6/D8/D10/D12/D20 — all dice needed for TRPG.
